flow: Post-ingest fanout checks whether an active approved master_binding is attached to the written shadow table.
evidence:
REF: /Users/trainguyen/Documents/work/data-hub/centralized-data-service/internal/handler/shadow/batch_buffer_fanout.go:174-187
	err := bb.db.WithContext(ctx).Raw(`
		SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt,
		       COALESCE(MAX(sb.binding_code), '') AS binding_code,
		       COALESCE(MAX(sb.shadow_schema), '') AS shadow_schema,
		       COALESCE(MAX(cr.connection_code), '') AS shadow_connection_key
		  FROM cdc_system.transmute_schedule ts
		  JOIN cdc_system.master_binding mb ON mb.id = ts.master_binding_id
		  JOIN cdc_system.shadow_binding sb ON sb.id = mb.shadow_binding_id
		  LEFT JOIN cdc_system.connection_registry cr ON cr.id = sb.shadow_connection_id
		 WHERE ts.mode = 'post_ingest' AND ts.is_enabled = true
		   AND mb.is_active = true AND mb.schema_status = 'approved'
		   AND sb.shadow_table = ?
		   AND COALESCE(sb.shadow_schema, '') = COALESCE(NULLIF(?, ''), COALESCE(sb.shadow_schema, ''))
	`, shadowTable, shadowSchema).Scan(&row).Error
